Claude Code extension restrictions (darwin)

Reviewed delivery target: /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.d/50-preloop-extensions.json
Delivery: endpoint_file (informational)
Minimum supported Claude Code version: 2.1.332 (conservative supported floor, not introduction version).
Older clients, or clients without managed-settings.d support, may ignore the file. No runtime version detection.

Export and registration do not prove installation. Never overwrite an existing managed source.
Deploy the hook bundle first when allowManagedHooksOnly is emitted.
No allow-list-only mode for plugins exists in Claude Code. Restrictions stop loading and do not delete files on disk.
A higher-precedence managed source (server-managed settings, MDM plist, registry) supersedes the file.
Name denials do not enforce content pins or version constraints.

Vendor admin-console delivery is unverified for agents routed through Preloop (non-default ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL). Prefer the endpoint file.
To paste JSON: Organization settings > Claude Code > Managed settings.
This client-side channel can be bypassed on unmanaged devices, caches for up to 24 hours, and is not delivered to cloud-provider sessions.
Use endpoint delivery for Preloop routes, personal plans and API keys.

Omitted:
enabledPlugins (hash:1234): not a marketplace plugin id

Settings:
{
  "enabledPlugins": {
    "unapproved@example": false
  }
}
